post.title: Proloquo2Go costs $249.99. Hope's Voice costs nothing.
post.caption: Four fresh grudges: a talking board for kids, break reminders, photo backup and an AI workspace, each built by someone who would not pay the toll.

segments.quote: A child who needs a talking board should not have to wait on a paid license.
